seo_title: Applied AI & Generative AI | Dataq Software
meta_description: Applied AI & Generative AI services from Dataq Software: scope, delivery pattern, platforms and committed outcomes.

blocks.x: Dataq Software's Applied AI & Generative AI practice: what the tower covers, the services inside it, the platforms it deploys and the outcomes typical programs commit to.

Applied AI & Generative AI at Dataq Software covers the full lifecycle of enterprise intelligence: strategy and value mapping, platform build-out, model adaptation, retrieval architectures, multimodal systems, and the governance fabric that keeps every model auditable. We do not run experiments for their own sake; every engagement is anchored to a named business metric, a named control owner, and a named risk budget.

Foundation-model capability is now a commodity; differentiated advantage has moved to the data layer, the retrieval layer, and the operating model around it. Enterprises that industrialize evaluation, guardrails, and cost control ship AI features in weeks and defend them in audit, while those that treat AI as a demo pipeline stall at pilot forty and lose credibility in the boardroom.

items: Align AI to P&L lines and risk mandates — a sequenced portfolio, not a pile of pilots.
One governed platform, many GenAI products: retrieval, guardrails and cost control as shared services.
Own your models: tune, distill and operate LLMs with measurable quality, controlled cost and enforceable policy.
Answers with citations, not vibes: permission-aware retrieval over your regulated document estate.
Models that read scans, scenes and schematics: multimodal intelligence wired into operations.
Voice and avatar interfaces that resolve, not deflect — with emotion-aware escalation and full auditability.
Replace hype with evidence: feasibility, value and adoption risk proven on your data in 6-10 weeks.

Typically +15-25 points over base frontier prompting on domain evals

blocks.x: Anchor industries: Agriculture & Food Systems, Banking & Financial Services, Education & Research, Energy & Utilities, Healthcare & Life Sciences, Insurance & Risk, Logistics & Supply Chain, Manufacturing & Industrial, Public Sector & Government, Retail & Consumer Goods, Technology & SaaS, Telecom, Media & Entertainment.

The engagement cadence below is the standard pattern for this capability. Weeks 1–2 lock the baseline: the current metric is measured with your team and signed before build starts. Weeks 3–8 deliver the pilot on bounded scope — one decision path, one workflow, one plant or one portfolio — with a control owner named on your side. Weeks 9–12 industrialize what worked: runbooks, monitoring, enablement and a measured delta against the signed baseline. Anything that misses its gate is stopped or redirected with a documented decision, not quietly extended.
The first quarter closes with the following artifacts handed over and walkthrough with your team:

items: The signed measurement of where the metric stands today, with the method written out so the number can be defended to finance.
Every automated decision path, its policy checks, its human checkpoint and its owner on one page.
Logs, evaluations and approvals collected automatically as the program runs — ready for internal audit or a regulator.
A running record of the delta against baseline, updated at every gate, reviewed at every steering meeting.
